statement: Draw a chain of straight segments from picked or typed points, with Close, Undo and Continue (restart from the last line or arc end) options.
superiority: Chain stays one undo step per pick and snaps to dimension-aware inference without a mode toggle.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Line, Polyline; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Script: LINE 0,0 10,0 10,5 C yields 3 lines; Continue starts at the prior endpoint; Undo removes only the last segment; endpoints exact to 1e-9.

statement: Create a 2D polyline mixing line and arc segments with per-segment width, Halfwidth, Length, Undo, Close and Arc sub-options (angle, center, direction, radius, second point).
superiority: Variable-width and bulge segments edit live with grips without exploding, and the same object converts to NURBS exactly.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Polyline, Curve; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Script a polyline with 2 line and 2 arc segments and a width taper; check vertex bulges equal tan(angle/4) and widths per segment; DXF LWPOLYLINE round trip keeps all.

statement: Create a 3D polyline of straight segments with free Z coordinates that stays a single object.
superiority: Edits as an ordinary curve with full 3D gumball instead of a limited vertex-only object.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Polyline; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Pick 4 points with different Z; object has 4 vertices, length equals sum of 3D segment lengths within 1e-9.

statement: Create a spline by fit points or control vertices with Method, Knots (chord, square root, uniform), Tolerance, tangents and Object conversion from polylines.
superiority: Exact NURBS with continuity analysis and curvature graph available at creation time.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers InterpCrv, Curve; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Fit-point spline passes through all picked points within the fit tolerance; CV method degree 3 has n+4 knots; converting a smoothed pline gives a spline within 1e-6.

statement: Create circles by center-radius, center-diameter, 2P, 3P, Ttr (tangent tangent radius) and Ttt.
superiority: Tangent circles remain associative to their tangent objects when constraints are added.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Circle; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Ttr between two lines with R=5 gives center at the expected closed-form point; 3P through unit-circle points gives radius 1 within 1e-12.

statement: Create arcs by 3 points, start-center-end, start-center-angle, start-center-length, start-end-angle/direction/radius, center-start-end and Continue.
superiority: All 11 methods reachable from one smart arc prompt with live preview of the alternate branch.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Arc; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Each of the 11 arc methods on a quarter circle of radius 10 gives sweep 90 degrees and radius 10 within 1e-9; direction of arc follows counterclockwise rule.

statement: Create full ellipses and elliptical arcs from axis endpoints and a distance, from center, with rotation and parameter/angle arc modes.
superiority: Exact conic curves with direct conversion to NURBS and no 2D-only restriction.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Ellipse; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Axis endpoints (0,0) (10,0) with other axis 4 gives area pi*5*4 within 1e-9; elliptical arc from 0 to 90 degrees has parametric bounds correct.

statement: Draw a rectangle polyline from two corners with Chamfer, Elevation, Fillet, Thickness, Width, Area, Dimensions and Rotation options.
superiority: Fillet and chamfer remain editable parameters after creation.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Rectangle; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Corner (0,0) to (10,6) with fillet 1 gives perimeter 32 - 8 + 2*pi (closed form 24+2*pi); Area option with length 10 and area 60 gives width 6; Rotation applies.

statement: Create a regular polygon of 3 to 1024 sides inscribed in or circumscribed about a circle, or by edge endpoints.
superiority: Side count and radius stay editable after creation.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Polygon, PolygonStar; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: 6-sided inscribed in R=10 has side 10; circumscribed in R=10 has apothem 10; edge mode through (0,0)-(4,0) gives side 4.

statement: Create a filled ring (wide closed polyline) from inside and outside diameters, repeating until Enter; zero inside diameter gives a solid disk.
superiority: Result can be a true planar surface with exact trim curves.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Circle, PlanarSrf; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: ID 2 OD 6 gives area pi*(9-1); ID 0 gives a filled disk of radius OD/2.

statement: Place point objects with PDMODE/PDSIZE display styles, plus DIVIDE and MEASURE to place points or blocks at equal parameter or distance steps.
superiority: Division by length or count also handles blocks aligned to curve tangent with exact arc-length parametrization.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Point, Divide; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: DIVIDE a 100-unit line into 5 gives 4 points at 20-unit spacing; MEASURE with distance 30 gives 3 points; display obeys PDMODE 35.

statement: Place points or blocks along an object at a specified distance interval from the start end, optionally aligning blocks.
superiority: Interval spacing reports leftover length and offers fit-to-ends in the same command.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Divide; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Polyline of length 100 measured at 30 gives points at 30,60,90 arc length; Block option with align rotates block to tangent.

statement: Create infinite construction lines by two points, horizontal, vertical, angle, bisector, or offset.
superiority: Construction lines participate in snapping and constraints but never affect zoom extents or plots.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Line; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Bisect option through three points gives line along the angle bisector; Offset 5 from a line gives parallel at distance 5; extents treated as infinite for snaps.

statement: Create semi-infinite construction lines from a start point through a second point, repeating until Enter.
superiority: Rays are excluded from extents and plot by default with a clear display style.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Line; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Ray from (0,0) through (1,1) intersects line x=5 at (5,5) via INTERSECT osnap.

statement: Draw a revision cloud as a polyline of arcs by freehand, rectangular, polygonal or from an object, with arc length min/max and Style (normal, calligraphy).
superiority: Cloud arcs regenerate when the boundary is stretched and carry revision metadata.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers RevCloud; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Rectangle 100 by 50 with arc length 5 produces arcs with chord lengths within the min/max; Reverse flips bulge direction; area closed.

statement: Create a masking polygonal region that hides objects behind it, from points, polyline, or by Frames on/off/display-only.
superiority: Mask is exact in vector PDF output instead of rasterized, and is selectable by frame in any mode.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Wipeout over a hatch hides it in plot output; Frames=off removes the border from view and from plot; DRAWORDER respected.

statement: Convert closed planar objects into region objects, and combine regions with UNION, SUBTRACT, INTERSECT for 2D areas.
superiority: 2D region booleans return exact trimmed planar surfaces and keep parent curves for history.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers PlanarSrf, BooleanUnion; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Two overlapping 10x10 squares offset by 5: union area 175, intersection 25, subtract 75 within 1e-9.

statement: Create a closed polyline or region from an area enclosed by objects at a picked internal point, with island detection and boundary set options.
superiority: Gap tolerance reported and optionally auto-closed with a visible preview of the repair.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry (looked for CurveBoundary, Boundary). Acceptance sketch: Pick inside a square with an inner circle: with island detection on returns two boundaries; gaps beyond tolerance fail with a clear error.

statement: Freehand sketch record with minimum segment length and polyline or spline output type.
superiority: Freehand input is fitted by a curve with error bound shown in the prompt.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Record increment 1.0 over a 10-unit stroke yields at least 10 vertices; Spline type output is smooth within 0.5 increment.

statement: Create a 2D or 3D helix by base radius, top radius, height, turns, turn height and twist direction.
superiority: Helix is an exact NURBS and feeds sweep and thread tools directly.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Helix, Spiral; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Radius 5 height 20 turns 4 has length 4*sqrt((2*pi*5)^2+5^2) within 1e-6; top radius different gives a conical helix.

statement: Draw multiline objects from an MLSTYLE with justification (top, zero, bottom), scale and style, with Undo and Close.
superiority: Multiline styles convert to editable offset curve sets with join logic exposed.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Offset; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Style with 3 elements at offsets 0.5,0,-0.5 and scale 2 gives lines at +-1 and 0; closed corner joins mitered.

statement: Define multiline styles with element offsets, colors, linetypes, caps and fill, saved in the drawing.
superiority: Styles are shareable between documents and imported by name.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Style with 2 elements, round end cap: MLINE end shows arc cap; style round-trips through DWG.

statement: Edit multiline junctions (cross open/closed/merged, tee, corner, add/delete vertex, cut, weld).
superiority: Junction cleanup is applied automatically and reversible.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Two crossing MLINEs with Closed Cross remove interior elements at the crossing; Tee trims one line to the other.

statement: Draw a solid band of given width along picked points with squared ends (legacy 2D trace).
superiority: Imports as filled planar surface.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Width 2 trace from (0,0) to (10,0) has 4 vertices and area 20; DXF TRACE entity preserved.

statement: Draw 2D filled quadrilaterals and triangles from 3 or 4 points with the fill crossing rule (third and fourth point swapped).
superiority: Fill order is explained interactively and corrected on request.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers PlanarSrf; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Points ordered 1,2,3,4 produce bow tie per rule; FILLMODE 0 hides fill; area for rectangle equals w*h.

statement: Set the point display style and size, relative to screen or absolute units.
superiority: Per-viewport point style overrides.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: PDMODE 3 PDSIZE -5 draws crosses 5 percent of viewport height; changing size regenerates at zoom change.

statement: Dimension and display the length of arcs and polyline arc segments (arc-length option, see also dimension section).
superiority: Arc length reported with exact tolerance in the properties panel.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Length; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Arc radius 10 sweep 90 gives 15.708; list shows within 1e-3.

statement: Type a distance with the cursor direction fixed to place the next point, working in LINE, PLINE, MOVE, COPY and other prompts.
superiority: Works with units, with scale-aware inference and unit suffix typing.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Cursor at 30 degrees, type 12 Enter: next point at 12*(cos30,sin30) within 1e-9, in ortho and polar modes.

statement: Show tooltip fields near the cursor for coordinate, distance and angle input, with Tab cycling, lock of entered values and a settings dialog.
superiority: Dynamic input is keyboard-accessible, screen-reader labelled and remappable.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Typing 5 Tab 30 Enter in LINE places a segment with length 5 at 30 degrees; locked fields hold when cursor moves.

statement: Accept absolute (x,y), relative (@x,y), polar (@d<a), cylindrical, spherical, and WCS (*) overrides in any point prompt, plus user coordinates via UCS.
superiority: One unified parser with unit-aware input and error message pointing at the offending token.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Line; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: @5<45 from (1,1) gives (1+3.5355,1+3.5355); *10,10 under rotated UCS gives WCS point; spherical @5<45<30 correct within 1e-9.

statement: From base point plus offset, Temporary Track Point (TT) and @ for last point to place geometry relative to known points.

source.ref: Last point and 'From' and temporary tracking
source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/ (topic: Last point and 'From' and temporary tracking)

superiority: Alignment paths are visible, labelled with distances, and survive pan.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: LINE from FROM base (0,0) offset @5,5 starts at (5,5); TT with two tracked points places at the intersection of their alignment paths.

statement: Convert lines and arcs into a polyline from the PEDIT Multiple Join option with fuzz distance and join type (extend, add, both).
superiority: Joining reports unjoined gaps and has a visible tolerance preview.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Join; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Three lines with end gaps 0.01 and fuzz 0.05 join to one closed polyline; Join type Add inserts bridging segments.

statement: Edit spline fit data, control vertices, tangents, knots, and convert to polyline with precision or close/open it.
superiority: Edit points stay visible through the edit and curvature combs update live.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers InsertKnot, InsertControlPoint; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Add fit point at (5,5) increases fit count by 1 and the curve passes through it; Refine adds a knot without changing shape within 1e-9.

statement: Insert a table object from a table style with row/column counts and sizes, by insertion point or window.
superiority: Cells accept formulas and live links natively.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Table; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Table 5 columns by 4 rows with column width 30 has width 150 and height set by row heights; cells accept text.

statement: Use .X .Y .Z point filters to build a point from coordinates of different picks.
superiority: Filters are visible in the prompt as typed chips.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: .X pick (3,0) then .YZ pick (0,7,2) gives (3,7,2).

statement: Reorder object display (bring to front, send to back, above/below object) and text/dimension/hatch to front.
superiority: Draw order stored per layout and reflected in both DWG and PDF.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Send hatch to back puts hatch behind boundary lines in plot output and in picking priority on equal depth.

statement: Bring all text, dimensions, leaders, or all annotation to the front of the display order in one command.
superiority: Annotation is on top by default and cannot be hidden accidentally.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: After TEXTTOFRONT All, a wipeout above text is below text in display order.

statement: Isolate, Hide, and Unisolate selected objects temporarily without changing layers.
superiority: Isolation is a lightweight view state shown with a persistent chip.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Isolate, Hide, Show; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: ISOLATEOBJECTS hides unselected; UNISOLATEOBJECTS restores; object isolation state not saved in layer table.

statement: Remove unused definitions: blocks, layers, linetypes, text and dimension styles, shapes, multiline styles, zero-length geometry and empty text.
superiority: Shows an exact reference-count report per item before removal.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Purge; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Purge All removes an unreferenced block definition and an empty layer but keeps in-use layers and the current layer.

statement: Remove duplicate and overlapping lines, arcs and polylines, optionally combine collinear/overlapping segments with tolerance and ignore properties.
superiority: Runs on the whole drawing with a diff preview and exact tolerance bound.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers SelDup; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Two coincident lines reduce to one; two overlapping collinear lines with partial overlap combine to one; tolerance 0.001 respected.
